title: Hullweather
summary: Start: enter Hullweather. The log opens the job and the helm marks the home buoy. Do: enter the ambush sight, 520 meters of the home buoy. The ambush holds until a keel crosses that line. Derelicts the size of stations. Tender work is the living. Finish: after the sight is sprung, come inside Station Hulk's shell. A drift rumor. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
